_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuV5cRafodM2YQHxeDkdiWJM)_

domain:spec#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVugtCCwBs98FeR27P
Fixes #30017
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no `skills/**` file teaches an `action:icon`, or an `action:group` / `action:menu` member, carrying `confirmText` beside an array `params` (`git grep` of `skills/` for `action:icon|action:group|action:menu`: 0 hits). The one rule line about the pair (`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` L22, "A registered action is refused it beside a non-empty `params` (put the question on `description`)") stays true and names the remedy this refusal prescribes. The generated `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` rows that render the three `confirmText` describes are regenerated here.

**BREAKING** accept-set narrowing at `ActionIconPropsSchema` and the `action:group` / `action:menu` member rows (`@objectstack/spec`), served where a page's component `properties` are judged: the component-props gate (`component-props-invalid`, `@objectstack/lint`) at every CLI command and at the runtime `page` save door.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：页面上的 `action:icon`，以及 `action:group` / `action:menu` 里的每个成员，同时写 `confirmText` 和非空数组 `params` 时，现在和 `action:button`、已注册动作、内联动作一样被拒收，提示把这句话挪到 `description`、删掉 `confirmText`。
- 为什么改：您在「Discuss pending spec rulings」线程对本卡裁定 A（「以上同意」）。这两类块把两键都交给同一个执行器，先弹确认框、再弹参数框，一个决定两个对话框；五道门现在用同一条判据、同一句提示。
- 风险与回滚：仓内普查 0 处已发运的载体，唯一命中是 spec 自己的一个测试夹具，本 PR 已改；不带 `params`、`params: []`、对象形 `params`（图标的静态值；`type: 'api'` 成员的请求体，都不弹参数框）照常通过。已存页面照常加载，下次保存才被拒。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`（`ActionIconPropsSchema` 链尾与 `buildActionGroupMember` / `buildActionMenuMember` 链尾新增的 `.refine`），`packages/spec/src/ui/action-confirm-params-guard.test.ts` 末尾新的 describe 组，`packages/spec/src/ui/component-report-items-action-members-typed.pin.test.ts` 改过的夹具。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/action-confirm-params-guard.test.ts`，预期 29 个测试全过，其中新组 8 条（5 条拒收、3 条对照）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **One predicate, one refusal, five doors.** `ActionIconPropsSchema` gains `.refine((data) => !declaresConfirmBesideParams(data), CONFIRM_BESIDE_PARAMS_REFUSAL)` at the end of its chain, exactly as `ActionButtonPropsSchema` carries it. The `action:group` and `action:menu` members each gain the same refine at the end of their builder's chain (`buildActionGroupMember`, `buildActionMenuMember`, the two consumers of `actionContainerMemberShape()`), so the issue lands on the member, at `actions.N.confirmText`. No second predicate or message: both are imported from `packages/spec/src/ui/action-confirm-beside-params.ts`, whose predicate and message are unchanged (the shared message needed no member-path variant: its remedy key, `description`, is declared on the icon and on both members); only its docblock now counts the five doors that read it.
- **The shared predicate already fits the ruling.** Its `Array.isArray(params) && params.length > 0` read refuses a non-empty array and leaves `params: []` and an object `params` alone: on `action:icon` an object is the static parameter values, on a member it is a `type: 'api'` member's request payload (a non-`api` member's object `params` stays refused by `actionContainerMemberParamsFitType`, unchanged).
- **The `confirmText` describes** of `action:icon` and of the container member shape now append the sentence `action:button`'s carries: refused beside a non-empty array `params`, correct with no `params`, beside `params: []` and beside an object `params` (the member's wording names the `type: 'api'` payload). `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` is regenerated from them (`check:generated --fix`, which proved only `check:docs` stale).
- **Census carrier repaired.** `component-report-items-action-members-typed.pin.test.ts` §1 "a member with every forwarded scalar" (`action:menu`) carried `confirmText` beside an array `params`; its `params` moves to a new byte-identical case, "a member collecting params", which carries the question on `description`.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/30017-action-icon-members-confirm-beside-params-refused.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor, both declaration lines, the ADR-0087 disposition marker (`registered`), the narrowing banner, before / now / unchanged / who, and the one-line fix naming the D3 entry.
- **Step-18 D3 entry** `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ui-page-action-row-confirm-text-beside-params-refused.ts` (added in the patch round, head `9d69f747cd`): one `SemanticMigration` naming all four page action rows (`properties.confirmText` beside a non-empty array `properties.params` on an `action:button` / `action:icon`, and `confirmText` beside a non-empty array `params` on each `action:group` / `action:menu` member), replacement on `description`, NOT mechanically convertible, acceptance as `os validate` reporting no `component-props-invalid` at those paths. It also covers the `action:button` refusal PR #29869 shipped without an entry.

### ADR-0087 disposition

The changeset body carries the ADR-0087 marker comment with the disposition `adr-0087: registered ui-page-action-row-confirm-text-beside-params-refused` (patch round, after contract review 6666209629: the refusal prescribes a hand rewrite, so ADR-0087 D3 owes an entry rather than an exemption). `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main` exits 0 and reads it as `registered`, the id new in this diff. No `docs/adr/**` path is touched. The first head carried `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`; that marker is gone.

- **AST pass** over every tracked `*.ts` / `*.tsx` / `*.js` / `*.mjs` / `*.cjs` / `*.mts` (no `dist/`, no `.d.ts`): 213 files contain `confirmText`; every object literal carrying both `confirmText` and a `params` that is not an empty array or an object literal was listed with the nearest enclosing `type` / `actionType` and the nearest enclosing array or call naming an `action:icon` / `action:group` / `action:menu` literal (the tuple-shaped fixtures). 48 such literals; 4 inside an action-block context, each read by hand:
  - `packages/spec/src/ui/component-report-items-action-members-typed.pin.test.ts` L217: an `action:menu` member (`type: 'api'`) with `confirmText` beside `params: [{ name: 'reason', … }]`. **The one carrier**; a test fixture, repaired here (above).
  - `packages/lint/src/validate-action-copy-templates.test.ts` L131: an `action:button` fixture (the `action:group` literal is a later array element); it feeds the copy-template rule, which does not parse these rows; the lint suite runs it green.
  - `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` L1156 and `component.zod.ts` L4138: schema declarations, not carriers.
- **Non-code pass** over tracked `*.json` / `*.yaml` / `*.yml` / `*.md` / `*.mdx` naming both `confirmText` and one of the three blocks (`CHANGELOG.md`, generated references, `json-schema/`, `api-surface`, `sdui.manifest.json` excluded): `content/docs/frontend/layout.mdx`, `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx`, `content/docs/ui/components/action.mdx`, `packages/spec/liveness/action.json`; each read by hand — prose and key tables, no example carrying the pair.
- Cloud fixtures are not in this repository and were not read. **Disposition: 0 shipped carriers, 1 test fixture (repaired).**

| `action:icon` with `confirmText` + array `params` | 1 · `component-props-invalid` · `error` · `…components[0].properties.confirmText` · "confirmText: An action that declares `confirmText` beside a non-empty `params` shows the u…" |
| `action:group` member, same pair | 1 · `component-props-invalid` · `error` · `…components[0].properties.actions.0.confirmText` |
| `action:menu` member, same pair | 1 · `component-props-invalid` · `error` · `…components[0].properties.actions.0.confirmText` |
| menu member, array `params` + `description` (the remedy) | 0 |

### Pins (`packages/spec/src/ui/action-confirm-params-guard.test.ts`, new top-level describe)

- Refusals (5): `action:icon` — one issue, `code: 'custom'`, `path: ['confirmText']`, message `toBe` `action:button`'s issue for the same pair, and contains `TWO dialogs`, `` `description` `` and `param-LESS`; `action:group` and `action:menu` members — one issue, `code: 'custom'`, `path: ['actions', 1, 'confirmText']` (the second member), message `toBe` `action:button`'s; and each member on the template-envelope `confirmText` form, `[['custom', 'actions.1.confirmText']]`.
- Preservation (3): `action:icon` and each container member accept `confirmText` with no `params`, beside `params: []`, beside an object `params` (`type: 'api'` on the members), and the remedy (array `params` + `description`), each a full `safeParse` success.

## Acceptance notes

- **The predicate module's docblock** now counts the five doors that read it (patch round, surface widened by amendment 6666273551); the predicate and the message are unchanged.
- **The `description` remedy on an `action:icon`.** With no `label`, an icon's `description` is also its tooltip text, so moving the confirm sentence there changes the tooltip too. The changeset's remedy says so; the shared message is unchanged.
- **`check:dev-prereqs`** (local-only family) exits 1 in this worktree: 35 `ui/` workspace packages have no `dist/` because no full `pnpm build` ran here. It judges whether this checkout can boot a dev server, not this diff.
